machine.note: API, worker, PostgreSQL and the load generator run on this same machine; other tenants may use the same PostgreSQL server and CPUs (see otherDatabasesTxPerSec and wholeMachineCpuPct).

workerKill.description: kill -9 of the worker while jobs were running (lease held), restart, drain
declaredShortcuts: called_timeout_sec set to 3 s in the scratch database
appointment slots moved into the past by SQL so the release timers are due

checks.check: the worker was killed while holding leases and with work left
nothing advances while the worker is down
all 210 timer jobs reach a terminal state after the restart
reservation_release effect applied exactly once for each of the 200 appointments (1 status change, 1 audit row, 1 event)
call_timeout effect applied exactly once for each of the 10 called entries
released capacity is returned exactly once (counters 0)
capacity/allocation invariants hold

ocrFail.description: booking at a constant 30 req/s for 40 s in three phases: baseline, OCR fixture "fail" with 2 uploads/s (80 documents), baseline again

checks.check: every booking succeeded (201) in all three phases
zero 5xx and zero network errors in all phases
documents with the failing fixture end in ocr_failed (visible, not lost) after bounded retries
invariants hold
after the failure period the same worker still processes a good document to ocr_ready

Terminating BUSY connections crashes the API: see dbCrash

each session ends with exactly its capacity booked (10 places x 6 sessions, 200 requests)
